onboarding.description: Beginner help for new HR admins (phase 5, 2026-10-01): every HR field a first-month admin could stall on. Exempt from the 4-per-screen cap. Thin it by removing a workspace here, not by deleting entries one by one.

payroll.tax_declaration.description: Investment declaration rows — My Tax & Investments › Declarations (MyTaxAndInvestmentsPage › DeclarationsTab)

section.hint: The part of the income-tax law this saving comes under. It decides how much of it can lower your tax.

askMaya.question: Which income tax section should I choose when declaring an investment or expense, and what kinds of payments count under 80C, 80D, 80CCD(1B), HRA and LTA?

proof_reference.hint: A link or receipt number that shows you paid. HR checks it before the amount counts towards your tax saving.

askMaya.question: What counts as proof for a tax-saving declaration, and how does HR check it?

verified_amount.hint: The amount HR accepted after checking your proof. It can be lower than what you declared if a receipt is missing or doesn’t cover it all.

askMaya.question: Why can the amount HR accepts for my tax declaration be lower than what I declared?

payroll.tax_regime.description: Old vs new regime choice — My Tax & Investments › Regime (MyTaxAndInvestmentsPage › RegimeTab)

regime_code.hint: The set of rules used to work out your income tax. Under the old one your declared savings count; under the new one most don’t.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between the old and new income tax regime, and how do I decide which one to choose for this financial year?

payroll.bank_details.description: Salary bank account editor — My Salary › Bank details (MySalaryPage)

ifsc_code.hint: An 11-character code for your bank branch, such as SBIN0001234. It’s on your cheque book or passbook and in your bank’s app.

askMaya.question: What is an IFSC code, and where can I find the one for my bank branch?

account_type.hint: Whether this is a savings or a current account. Salary almost always goes into a savings account.

askMaya.question: Should my salary be paid into a savings account or a current account, and what is the difference between them for salary payments?

attendance.regularization.description: Attendance correction request — My Attendance › Corrections › New request (RegularizationCard › RegularizationFormModal)

work_mode.hint: Where you worked that day. Leave it as recorded unless it was logged wrongly — it only changes if the correction is approved.

askMaya.question: When I request an attendance correction, what does the ‘Worked from’ option mean, and what is the difference between office, remote, field and hybrid work?

payroll.reimbursement_claim.description: Expense line in a reimbursement claim — My Reimbursements › New claim (MyReimbursementsPage › ClaimEditorDialog)

category_id.hint: The type of expense, such as travel or food. Your organisation sets these, and each can have its own limit and receipt rule.

askMaya.question: How do I choose the right expense category for a reimbursement claim, and when do I need to attach a receipt?

documents.upload.description: Add a document / upload a new version (shared DocumentUploadDialog — also used by HR and managers, hence the workspace gate)

document_number.hint: The number printed on the document itself, such as a PAN or passport number. It’s stored securely; only the last 4 characters are shown.

askMaya.question: Why does HR Clouds ask for the number printed on a document, and how is it kept safe?

is_confidential.hint: Hides this document from your manager — only you and HR can see it. Once it’s confidential, it can’t be made visible again.

askMaya.question: What happens when I mark a document as confidential, who can still see it, and can I change it back later?

leaves.apply.description: Apply for leave drawer (LeaveDashboard › ApplyLeaveDrawer; also mounted under the HR and manager prefixes). Holds the form field plus the balance strip: `pending_hold` is summed client-side from requests still pending, and “Effective” = current_balance − pending_hold (explained in the same hint).

leave_type_id.hint: The kind of leave you’re taking, such as sick or casual. Each has its own balance and rules; days beyond your balance may be unpaid.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between leave types such as casual, sick and earned leave, and what happens if I apply for more days than my leave balance?

pending_hold.hint: Days in your requests still waiting for approval. They’re set aside, so “Effective” is what you can still apply for.

askMaya.question: What does pending hold mean on my leave balance, and when are held days given back or taken from my balance?

attendance.summary.description: Month headline figures from /attendance/graph-data › summary (EmployeeDashboard › My month)

punctuality_percentage.hint: Of the days you clocked in this month, the share you arrived on time. Arriving within your grace period still counts as on time.

askMaya.question: How is on-time arrival worked out in attendance, and what is the grace period for clocking in late?

attendance.anomalies.description: My Flags list (/attendance/anomalies/mine) › “Flag” column — `type`, falling back to `anomaly_type`

type.hint: Your manager or HR reviews each flag and marks it sorted out. If one looks wrong, talk to them — you don’t need to raise it anywhere else.

askMaya.question: What does it mean when my attendance is flagged, for example outside the office location or a break over the limit, and what should I do about it?

leaves.balances.description: Leave balance cards (/leaves/my-balances) — one ⓘ on the “Leave Balances” heading covers “given so far” (`total_accrued`) on every card

total_accrued.hint: “Given so far” is the leave added this year — all at once or month by month, depending on your policy. “Days left” is what you can still take.

askMaya.question: How is leave added to my balance during the year, and what happens to unused leave at the end of the year?

unpaid_days.hint: Days beyond your leave balance are taken without pay, so that month’s salary is lower. The split is worked out when you submit.

askMaya.question: What is leave without pay (LWP), when does leave become unpaid, and how does it reduce my salary?

payroll.my_salary.description: My Salary headline (/payroll/me/salary-structure). `take_home_monthly` is derived by statutoryTotals() — gross minus statutory and salary deductions.

annual_ctc.hint: The company’s total yearly cost for you, not what you’re paid. Deductions such as PF and tax come off first, so what reaches your bank is lower.

askMaya.question: What is CTC (cost to company), and why is my take-home pay lower than my CTC?

take_home_monthly.hint: An estimate from your salary structure. What actually reaches your bank each month can change with unpaid leave, attendance and tax.

askMaya.question: Why can the salary that reaches my bank differ from month to month, and what affects my take-home pay?

payroll.statutory.description: Statutory deduction lines (StatutoryBreakdown AmountTable). Wired generically by `line.key` (pf, esi, pt, tds, pf_employer, esi_employer, edli, pf_admin) — only the keys listed here show an ⓘ.

pf.hint: Part of your pay saved into your provident fund account, with the company adding its own share. It’s your money, for retirement.

askMaya.question: What is the provident fund (EPF) deduction from salary, how much is deducted, and how can I withdraw or check my PF balance?

pt.hint: A small tax charged by some states on salaried people. Whether it applies, and how much, depends on the state you work in.

askMaya.question: What is professional tax, how is it calculated, and why does it differ between states?

payable_days.hint: The days you’re paid for this month. Unpaid leave and unrecorded absences bring it below the number of days in the month.

askMaya.question: What are paid days on a payslip, and why can they be fewer than the days in the month?

remaining_tds.hint: Income tax for the year that hasn’t been taken from your pay yet. It’s spread over the months left, so it changes if your pay or declarations do.

askMaya.question: How is income tax (TDS) deducted from my salary each month, and why does the monthly amount change during the year?

previous_employer.hint: Pay and tax from a job you left earlier this financial year. It’s added in so your tax for the whole year is worked out correctly.

askMaya.question: Why does income from my previous employer this year affect my tax, and what is Form 12B?

standard_deduction.hint: A fixed amount taken off your salary before tax is worked out. It’s given automatically — you don’t need to declare or prove anything.

askMaya.question: What is the standard deduction on salary income, and how does it reduce my income tax?

form16.hint: Your yearly tax certificate from the company. Part A lists the tax deposited for you; Part B shows how it was worked out. You use it to file your return.

askMaya.question: What is Form 16, what is the difference between Part A and Part B, and how do I use it to file my income tax return?

payroll.loans.description: Loan detail dialog (/payroll/me/loans) › “How interest is worked out” (`interest_method`)

interest_method.hint: Flat charges interest on the full amount for the whole loan. “On what’s still owed” charges it only on the unpaid part, so it costs you less.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between flat interest and reducing balance interest on a salary loan?

divisor_days.hint: Your monthly pay is divided by this many days to get one day’s rate. The number is set by your company’s policy.

askMaya.question: How is the amount for leave encashment calculated, and what does dividing the month by a number of days mean?

payroll.reimbursement_limits.description: My Claims & Benefits › Limits tab (/payroll/me/reimbursements/categories) › “Period limit” column

period_limit.hint: The most you can claim in this category in each period, such as a month. It starts again each period; “Per claim” caps a single claim.

askMaya.question: How do reimbursement limits work, what is the difference between a per-claim limit and a period limit, and when do they reset?

status.hint: In review: HR hasn’t checked it yet. Action required: HR sent it back — upload it again. Not finished: the upload didn’t complete.

askMaya.question: What do the document statuses in review, action required, not finished and expiring soon mean, and what do I need to do for each?

documents.company_documents.description: My Company Documents › status filter (`compliance_state`: pending, overdue, completed, waived)

compliance_state.hint: Needs you: read, acknowledge or sign it. Overdue: its due date has passed. Excused: HR decided you don’t need to act on it.

askMaya.question: What do I need to do with documents issued to me by the company, and what do needs you, overdue and excused mean?

organization.org_chart.description: Org Chart (OrgChartPage) — stat tiles, and the person dialog (OrgPersonDialog). depth, biggest_team, team_size and level are derived in orgChartMeta.js; reporting_to_id is the hierarchy node key.

depth.hint: How many layers there are from the top of the organisation down to the people furthest from it.

askMaya.question: What does the number of levels in an org chart say about an organisation?

biggest_team.hint: The most people who report directly to one person. People further down their line aren’t counted here.

askMaya.question: What is a span of control, and how many direct reports is usual for one manager?

reporting_to_id.hint: Who this person reports to, all the way up. The manager directly above them is the one who reviews their leave and attendance requests.

askMaya.question: What is a reporting line in a company, and how does the person I report to affect who reviews my leave and attendance requests?

team_size.hint: Everyone below this person on the chart: the people who report to them, the people who report to those people, and so on.

askMaya.question: What is the difference between direct reports and everyone under a person in an org chart?

level.hint: How far down the chart this person sits. Level 1 is the top of the organisation; each step down adds one.

askMaya.question: How are levels counted in an org chart?

organization.company_profile.description: Company Profile (CompanyProfilePage) — the People headline and the HR-only Tax & legal registration card. Keys are GET /organizations/details response keys.

total_active_members.hint: People who have joined and can sign in today. Invitations not yet accepted and people who have left aren’t counted.

askMaya.question: Who counts as an active member of the organisation in HR Clouds?
